Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring institutions of higher education to provide early registration for eligible veterans and national guard members.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to early registration at institutions of highereducation for eligible veterans and national guard members; and addinga new section to chapter 28B.15 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.15 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Beginning in the academic year 201213, institutions of highereducation must have a process in place to offer students who areeligible veterans or national guard members early registration asfollows: (a) New students who are eligible veterans or national guardmembers shall be offered an early registration period; and (b) Continuing students who are eligible veterans or national guardmembers shall be offered early registration according to institutionalpolicies. (2) For the purposes of this section "eligible veterans or nationalguard members" has the definition in RCW 28B.15.621.
